label: dense near-always-on feature (off mainly at <DEL> step)
explanation: Fires on 86% of all steps in every sequence. The only real structure is that it is suppressed at the delimiter step (rate 0.37 vs ~0.9 elsewhere) and gets weaker late in the original phase of long sequences (orig_idx 6-8 rate 0.66-0.08). phase != 1 gets dev F1 0.93, but predicting every step already gets about 0.92, so the predicate adds almost nothing over the base rate. Magnitude is largest at original positions 1-4 (t=2-3 carry the most mass), and the largest activations come from sequences starting with z z b / z z z (b at position 3 hits the max). Token identity, out_tok, first_tok, n_digits and correctness barely matter (lift ~1.0x). No coherent semantic trigger was found.
